correctness.rationale: The prime-power formula eliminates repeated factors, and parity eliminates even composites. Odd squarefree composite residue-one cases require an odd multiplier at least 3, so \(\psi(n)/n>3\). Local divisibility forbids distinct support primes \(q\equiv-1\pmod r\). Every support pattern intersects \(B=\{3,5,7,11,13\}\) in one of exactly fifteen compatible subsets. The first 709 eligible factors give a universal majorant for support size at most 709. The embedded standard-library certificate enumerates all masks, produces all 709 primes in every branch from a complete sieve, and proves each rational product is below 3 with exact integers. Therefore the unrestricted support bound holds.

value.rationale: The problem is the explicit prime-only conjecture attached to the exact Dedekind residue sequence. Excluding all composites below 710 distinct factors is a substantial structural restriction, not an arbitrary fiber recomputation or a bounded search. The arithmetic mechanism integrates forced squarefreeness, parity, a quotient at least 3, and a complete local-residue sieve; its stopping value is naturally tied to the first 709 eligible Euler factors in the worst allowed branch.
